def max_sum_pair_diff_lessthan_K(arr, k, n):
    arr.sort()
    i = 0
    j = n - 1
    res = 0
    while i < j:
        if arr[i] + arr[j] <= k:
            res += arr[i] + arr[j]
            i += 1
            j -= 1
        else:
            j -= 1
    return res
